{{Quote|Brilliant! Such showmanship! Such panache! Such verve!|A Swokes Swokes dilettante, on Raal Yorta|<ref name="Rookies: Rendezvous">''[[Rookies: Rendezvous]]''</ref>}}
A [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Swokes Swokes/Legends|Swokes Swokes]] '''dilettante''' played [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] against the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]] [[Ten-Suckers Madoom]] and the [[Human/Legends|Human]] gambler [[Raal Yorta]]. When Yorta won a large payout, she found the gambler's style attractive, hinting at her desire for wealth. She was unmarried at the [[Time/Legends|time]].
